sessions.phase_label: Review-material handoff, initial delivery, and rejection
Contract termination dispute and conditional correction opportunity

requirements.title: Danish Voiceover Audit
requirements.definition: Review the supplied Danish voiceover by listening to it, marking voiceover errors, and recording relevant audit comments in the provided feedback structure rather than returning unrelated or AI-generated content.
requirements.boundary_note: Audit method, error marking, comment placement, and output relevance are acceptance attributes of one voiceover-audit deliverable. The separately performed text proofreading has its own acceptance and failure trajectory.

requirements.title: Danish Text Proofreading
requirements.definition: Proofread and revise the Danish text to produce an accurate, usable result through genuine review rather than untrusted AI-generated work.
requirements.boundary_note: Text proofreading is separate from the voiceover audit because the freelancer claims the text was reviewed independently, while the client separately evaluates its accuracy and suspected AI provenance.
